Subject: Dedicated pod needs for Q4 PoC - AstraNova

Hi Kimberly / Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency numbers looked promising. We are moving into the final technical validation for our Q4 proof-of-concept and need to lock down expected dedicated capacity for a 60–90 day PoC. High-level requirements below: 

- Target model: open-llama-34b variant, 16-bit/4-bit quantization permissable
- Peak concurrent inference: 18 sustained sessions (~1.5k tokens/min average each)
- Typical sequence length: 1k tokens, worst-case 2.5k tokens
- Preferred GPU shape: A100 80GB or equivalent (NVIDIA H100 would be fine but prefer cost estimate)
- Start window: mid-Oct (flexible by 2 weeks)

We expect to finalize commercials by end of July, but would like Redwood to provision or soft-reserve capacity while contracts and SOC 2 paperwork finish. Can you confirm whether you have a staging/dedicated pool that can accommodate ~6 nodes (80GB equiv) for the PoC window? Also attaching an early SOW draft for context.

Best,
Natalie
Natalie Hart
CTO, AstraNova
AstraNova (external prospect)

- We can provision a dedicated pool that would meet the 6x80GB equivalent target for a 60–90 day PoC.
- We can offer a provisional soft-hold for up to 45 days while the contract is finalized; any longer hold requires a nominal commitment fee (we can route through Finance once you signal final intent).
- Need to confirm QPS and expected traffic profile (burstiness) to size autoscaling/burst options — will Aditya please collect that from the AstraNova side and share?

Next steps: Ben, can you run a quick availability check and propose node mappings + estimated monthly run-rate for the target window? Aditya, can you confirm whether AstraNova wants H100 or A100 pricing first-pass?

Kim / Aditya — did the availability check this morning and sketched a few options. Quoted below is the summary; attaching the raw capacity matrix.

Quoted requirements (from Natalie): ~6 nodes 80GB-equivalent for 60–90d, sustained sessions ~18, typical seq 1k tokens.

Option A (conservative, 80GB A100 nodes):
- Map: 6 x A100-80GB on dedicated pool alpha-2 (us-west)
- Estimated provisioning lead time: 7–10 business days from soft-hold confirmation
- Expected tail latency: median 45ms token, 95p 110ms (with continuous batching enabled)
- Cost (first-pass): $98k/month (includes managed infra + support), prorated for PoC length

Option B (cost-optimized, mixed H100 spot-capacity + A100 reserve):
- Map: 3 x A100-80GB reserved + 3 x H100 opportunistic with fallback to A100
- Lead time: 5–8 business days for reserved portion; opportunistic nodes require readiness for fallback
- Cost (first-pass): $74k/month estimated (savings from opportunistic H100 usage + dynamic routing)

Operational notes and constraints: 
- We currently have capacity window in us-west for the requested dates but not guaranteed unless we place a provisional soft-hold.
- A soft-hold (internal booking) will reserve the A100 slots within alpha-2 for up to 45 calendar days. After 45d we need a signed commitment or we release capacity to the pool.
- We can support an automated fallback policy to route traffic to hosted variants if dedicated capacity is temporarily exhausted; there will be a small latency and cost tradeoff.

Attachments: capacity-matrix.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)

Action items: 
- Kimberly: confirm soft-hold length to offer AstraNova (45d default, or 60d with approval).
- Aditya: confirm AstraNova preference for H100 vs A100 baseline pricing and expected burst patterns.
- Marcus/Dev: flag any infra constraints (thermal/maintenance windows) for alpha-2 during Oct window.

Ben Carter
Capacity Ops, Redwood Inference
